headline: Wages and pensions of Ukrainians in Australia: Rada ratifies agreement on avoidance of double taxation - sud.ua
summary: Ukraine's Rada ratified an agreement with Australia setting rules for taxing wages, pensions and other income, including tax credits and protection against double taxation once in force.
why: Double taxation treaties define how cross-border income is taxed, affecting investors, employers and pension recipients operating between the two countries.
